title: Rob Markman drops 'Boring' featuring Wave Matthews produced by The Track Burnaz
htmlContent: [caption id="attachment_255359" align="alignnone" width="1288"] Photo Credit - Rob Markman[/caption] Rob Markman shares his thoughts on being with a girl that is not very complicated in his new single 'Boring' is produced by The Track Burnaz. He also enlist the services of Wave Matthews as the featured artist on the track. Being with a girl that is not very complicated is not necessarily a bad thing after all. The single can be streamed on all of your favorite platforms.
